service_level.measurement: YouTube viewing on home Wi-Fi devices
service_level.share_scope: Barb service-level measurement across in-home connected devices; separate from channel-level 200-channel panel

separate_channel_measurement.population: Selected high-viewing channels, not a YouTube channel census

related_ofcom_2026.metric: UK YouTube minutes per person per day (Barb in-home)
related_ofcom_2026.relationship: TV time is a SUBSET of all in-home device time, not extra time to add.
related_ofcom_2026.not_comparable_with: Ofcom Online Nation 2025 average of 51 minutes excluding television, which uses a different methodology.

comparison_prohibitions: Do not identify 43% TV viewing with 43% of distinct adult people who use YouTube.
Do not treat the 32% smartphone share as all UK smartphone viewing; home Wi-Fi only.
Do not apply the 200 selected-channel ACR exclusions to the separate all-service device share observations.
Do not add 19 minutes of television viewing to 41 minutes of all-device in-home YouTube; television is included in all devices.
Do not combine Ofcom's 51 minutes excluding TV with Barb's 41 home-device minutes, which have different sample and observation frames.
Do not infer a causal content or monetization advantage for either device from viewing shares.
Children's aggregated device share is not permission to profile, identify or target individual minors.
